sections.extract: arXiv:math/0108046v3 [math.RT] 3 May 2002 PRESENTING SCHUR ALGEBRAS STEPHEN DOTY AND ANTHONY GIAQUINTO Abstract. Motivated by work of R.M. Green, we obtain a pre- sentation of Schur algebras (both the classical and quantized ver- sions) in terms of generators and relations.
